fields.features_heading: What Happens Between the Search and the Call
fields.features_subheading: The page earns its keep after the visit. Emergent builds each part below from your prompt and changes it on request.
fields.feature_1:
Audit questions asked one screen at a time

The audit request asks one question per screen, and the next field appears only after the prospect answers the site address. Reorder the questions by writing one more prompt.
fields.feature_2:
Every request kept in a table you own

Each request lands as a row in a database you own, with the budget in its own column. Sort the rows by budget each Monday morning and call the largest accounts first.
fields.feature_3:
A strategist hears about large budgets first

Set a budget line in plain words and the app emails the strategist on every request above it. Slack and in-app alerts work the same way, with a reminder if nobody replies.
fields.feature_4:
Leads sent to the CRM your sales team uses

The app connects to any tool with an API. HubSpot is one example: each new lead is created there as a contact, so the sales team keeps working from the pipeline it knows.
fields.feature_5:
A new city or service added by message

Ask for a page for Tulsa or a link building offer, and Emergent adds the page with its own form, matching the rest of the site. Leads from the new page join the same table.
fields.feature_6:
Your own domain and code to keep

Custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and hand it to a developer when the agency needs more.

fields.usecase_heading: SEO Agency Landing Page Examples by Offer
fields.tab_content_1:
A $2,500 monthly budget alerts the strategist

Ridgeloft Search offers local businesses a free audit. The form asks for the site address and the 3 keywords the owner wants to rank for, then the monthly budget. Odell Prask of Garrowby Plumbing entered $2,500, above the agency's $2,000 line. The app emailed strategist Juno Ferrante and saved his request as a row.
fields.tab_content_2:
One page for each of 12 service cities

Briarcombe Local wins clients city by city, with a page for each of the 12 cities it serves. Every page carries the same short form and tags each lead with its city. Tamsin Rook of Rook Family Dental wrote in from the Norman page, and her lead saved with the Norman tag.
fields.tab_content_3:
In October, 11 of 18 leads chose Growth at $2,400

Lantern Ridge SEO prints its prices: Growth at $2,400 a month and Scale at $4,800. Each Choose button opens a short form that saves the plan with the lead. In October, 11 of the 18 leads picked Growth, the latest being Lisette Varga, who runs a bakery chain.
fields.tab_content_4:
Any store with over 5,000 products gets a technical audit call

Thistlecrest Growth only works with online stores, and its page asks each one for its product count. Galloway Trail Supply listed 8,200 products, past the 5,000 line. Rhea Okonkwo was offered a technical audit call, and the app created her lead as a contact in HubSpot through its API.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an SEO Agency Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Follow these 7 steps to plan an SEO agency landing page that turns audit requests into sales calls, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the service your best clients buy
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Decide what the free audit covers
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Show proof a buyer can check
fields.howto_step_1_des: Choose one service for the page, such as local SEO for dental practices or technical SEO for large online stores. Write the headline for that buyer and that service, and name the result the buyer pays for, such as more calls from search.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Settle the scope of the free audit before you write the button, such as a crawl of up to 500 pages and a 20-minute call to walk through it. Name those limits on the page next to the request button.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Ask only what you need to qualify a lead and prepare the audit. Keep it to four or five questions. Put the budget question last, and write the budget line that should bring a strategist in.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Google's guide to hiring an SEO suggests asking for examples of previous work and success stories. Answer that on the page with short case studies that name the client's industry and the work you did.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Put a price near the main button
fields.howto_step_5_des: Show the monthly retainer, or a starting price, next to the request button. Spend the sales call on scope instead of cost. If every account is priced by hand, say what the price depends on.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Connect the page to your CRM, or treat the leads table as the pipeline if the agency has no CRM yet. Check that a new lead arrives with its budget and the page it came from before launch.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send a test request from your phone
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill in the form on a phone as a test business with a budget above the strategist line. Check that the alert email arrives and the row saves with every answer. Then send one below the line and confirm no alert goes out.

faq_plan.q: What is an SEO agency landing page?
faq_plan.a: An SEO agency landing page is a single page that sells one of an agency's search services, such as a free audit or local SEO, and asks the visitor to send a request. Its form saves each request as a lead the agency can call back.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an SEO agency landing page?
faq_plan.a: Describe the page in a prompt to Emergent's AI landing page builder: the service, the free offer, the form questions, and where each lead should go. Emergent builds the page and its form from that prompt, and you change any part by prompting again. The free tier covers building and publishing.

faq_plan.q: What sections does an SEO agency landing page need?
faq_plan.a: Put one service in the headline, then proof of past work and a price or starting price. Close with a request form short enough to finish on a phone. Add a line on what the monthly report covers, such as rankings for the client's target keywords.

faq_plan.q: Should an SEO agency landing page show case studies?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Put two or three short case studies near the request form rather than linking to a long portfolio. Lead each with the client's industry and the search number that changed, and say how long the change took. A design agency landing page shows finished work as images, while an SEO case study shows the chart.

faq_plan.q: Should an SEO agency landing page promise first-page rankings?
faq_plan.a: No. Google's guidance on hiring an SEO is direct: no one can promise a #1 ranking on Google. Promise the work instead, such as the audit and a monthly report on rankings and traffic, and keep any ranking language to what past clients achieved.

faq_plan.q: Should an SEO agency landing page list retainer prices?
faq_plan.a: List them if the agency sells fixed monthly retainers, and put the price where a prospect sees it before the booking button. If every account is quoted by hand, give a starting price and say what moves it. On a page built with Emergent, the plan each lead picks saves to a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Should an SEO agency landing page offer a free audit or a free strategy call?
faq_plan.a: Offer the audit if the agency can deliver it within a few days, and a call if the work depends on talking first. A call books the way a discovery session does on a coaching landing page: set a length and show open times. You can also offer both, with the call booked after the audit arrives.

faq_plan.q: What questions should the form on an SEO agency landing page ask?
faq_plan.a: Beyond the site address and the budget, ask for the main competitor and the city or country the business sells in. Those two answers shape the audit before anyone opens the site. Emergent can build the form to ask one question per screen.

faq_plan.q: How do I write an SEO agency landing page for one city?
faq_plan.a: Write it from that city's work, with local clients and examples, rather than swapping the city name into a copy of another page. Build one only where the agency has that local proof to show. When you need a page for a new city, Emergent adds it from one more prompt.

faq_plan.q: How many SEO agency landing pages does an agency with several services need?
faq_plan.a: Build one for each service that has its own buyer. Give local SEO for medical clinics and ecommerce SEO for national retailers separate pages, each with its own proof and request form. A consulting landing page follows the same pattern, with one page per practice area.

plan.angle: Someone searching for an SEO agency landing page runs or is starting an SEO agency and wants a page that turns search visitors into qualified audit requests. Template galleries stop at a hero and a contact form. This page shows four SEO agency pages built from a prompt and follows each lead to where it lands: a free audit request that captures the site and three target keywords and alerts the strategist when the monthly budget clears $2,000, a local SEO agency with one page per service city that tags each lead with its city, a retainer pricing page that saves the plan each lead picked, and an ecommerce SEO page that offers large stores a technical audit call and sends the lead to the agency's CRM. The FAQ covers the definition, what to put on the page, proof of results, ranking promises, pricing, the audit offer, the form questions, city pages and service pages. Design agency, coaching and consulting pages are siblings and stay out of the headings.
